name: Viv Andrews
quote: Half an hour with DreamLab produced three years of practicable strategy. Previously unfathomable depths of planning achieved in the blink of an eye.

name: Peter Woodbridge
quote: If you want to move past the superficial hype of prompt engineering and actually learn how to architect autonomous systems, Dr. John O'Hare's training is the gold standard. He quite literally taught me everything I know about Agentic AI, taking me from a conceptual understanding to being able to build and deploy sophisticated, multi-agent frameworks.

name: Google reviewer
quote: A thoroughly enjoyable few days getting familiar with Claude, GitHub and basic principles of utilising AI for engineering. I've since built, tested and released a superb desktop UI to support complex trading platform integration. As if having a mainline of functional information wasn't enough it was all delivered in their incredibly beautiful premises in the lakes. Thanks DreamLab. Dreamy.
